title: Zoning map change for 289 Kent Avenue, Williamsburg
summary: This application would rezone property at 289 Kent Avenue in Williamsburg, Brooklyn to allow an 18-story mixed-use building with 278 apartments, including 56 to 83 permanently income-restricted units, plus about 29,300 square feet of ground floor commercial space. It changes the current M3-1 manufacturing district to M1-3A/R7X and M1-2A districts and creates a Special Mixed Use District. The City Council held a public hearing on September 9, 2026 and approved the change on October 8, 2026.
